thread:
maria-cs: Customer on Dedicated reported per-model throughput graphs flatlined, started ~10:14am PT. They see 0 QPS on all model lines.
jamie-eng-platform: thanks — which org and dashboard link? can you screenshot?
maria-cs: org=acme-ai, dashboard path /orgs/acme/models/throughput — screenshot uploaded.
alex-oncall: checking prometheus... I don't see any series with label `model` for `redwood_model_qps`.
sara-telemetry: we pushed tag-rotation v2 to telemetry yesterday. we renamed `model` -> `model_name` in the exporter labels.
jamie-eng-platform: that would explain it. Grafana panels query by `model` label. can someone run: ```promql
count by (model) (rate(redwood_model_qps[5m]))
```
alex-oncall: ran that -> returns zero series. but `metric_metadata(redwood_model_qps)` shows series exist with `model_name`.
maria-cs: customer on a demo in 20 minutes, marking P1.
jamie-eng-platform: short-term options: (A) patch Grafana queries to use `model_name`, scoped to acme dashboards, or (B) deploy a quick compatibility relabeler that copies `model_name` -> `model` in exporter.
sara-telemetry: (B) requires deploy, riskier. (A) is quick and reversible.
alex-oncall: I can edit acme's dashboard variables and panel queries now. I'll replace occurrences of `label_values(model)` with `label_values(model_name)` and update panel queries accordingly. patching in place.
jamie-eng-platform: make it only on acme org dashboards; do not change global templates.
alex-oncall: done. pushed update to acme dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/acme/models/throughput :thumbsup:
maria-cs: customer confirmed graphs come back live, they see normal QPS lines.
deploy-bot: deploy job started: telemetry/tag-rotation rollback -> staging (job #5421)
sara-telemetry: we'll roll the exporter back to reintroduce the `model` label and add a compatibility shim in next release.
jamie-eng-platform: follow-ups: 1) add a deploy-gate test that fails if label schema changes without migration; 2) add alert if per-model series count drops >75% for >10m; 3) add a dashboard migration script for org-specific dashboards.
alex-oncall: filed incident INC-2026, linked traces + prom queries + dashboard diff.
maria-cs: thanks everyone — customer demo recovered. I'll send a short note to acme with what happened and next steps.
jamie-eng-platform: FYI ops: tagging this for postmortem and release notes. also add a note to rollout checklist about label changes.
sara-telemetry: taking ownership of the postmortem. will schedule RCA sync tomorrow.

Logs / snippets from investigation:
```
# shows exporter labels after v2
redwood_model_qps{instance="10.3.1.2:9100",job="exporter",model_name="gptx",region="us-west"} 42
# old metric (no longer present)
# redwood_model_qps{instance="10.3.1.2:9100",job="exporter",model="gptx",region="us-west"} 42
```

Quick remediation steps used:
- Patch acme dashboard queries to reference `model_name` (scoped change)
- Confirmed with customer
- Started rollback job for exporter to restore `model` label

Outcome: graphs restored for acme; rollback in progress; postmortem planned.
